title: Cup of Joe's 'Symphony' concert gets 2nd Day: 'You asked, we listened'
summary: OPM band Cup of Joe announced Day 2 of their upcoming concert "Symphony" on December 4 at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao, Quezon City.
